name: migatronix
description: MIGATRONIX tools for Claude Code: plan-usage meter for the macOS menu bar and Windows tray, and a live context and token meter above the prompt.

plugins.name: usage-meter-mac
plugins.description: Claude plan usage (5-hour and weekly, % used, time to reset) in the Claude Code status line and the macOS menu bar.

plugins.name: usage-meter-windows
plugins.description: Claude plan usage (5-hour and weekly, % used, time to reset) in the Claude Code status line and the Windows tray.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Live context and token-limit meter above the prompt, with colors and a guard that holds prompts near the limit. Works on macOS and Windows.
